class.name: DismembermentComponent
class.brief_description: Procedurally detach or hide bone subtrees from a skinned character.
class.description: Assign a Skeleton3D and skinned MeshInstance3D using skeleton_path and mesh_path, or use the editor setup dock. Bone names are exact and distances are meters. Remapping occurs before filtering. Cleanup removes detached objects; reset restores the character. Network commands require network_enabled and an explicitly authorized owning_peer_id.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Validate the source and cache per-instance state. Inspect get_last_error() when false.

method.name: dismember_limb
method.description: Detach a valid, available subtree and apply a physics impulse after pose setup. Duplicate and filtered cuts have no effect.

method.name: destroy_limb
method.description: Remove a subtree without spawning a detached limb.

method.name: reset_all_limbs
method.description: Restore source geometry, attachments, collision and replicated state, and remove detached limbs.

members.member: Scale applied to geometry outside the detached subtree in Bone Collapse mode. A value of [code]0.01[/code] retains one percent of the original scale.
Block new requests to detach or hide limbs. Limbs already removed stay missing until reset.
Case-sensitive bone names that cannot be selected as cut roots. Exclusions take priority over [member whitelist_bones] after remapping.
Bone Collapse keeps the skin and collapses the cut geometry. Triangle Partition separates the mesh triangles by skin weight. Restore the missing limbs before switching modes.
3D physics layers assigned to detached limb bodies, including cloned physical bones and fallback rigid bodies.
3D physics layers that detached limb bodies can collide with.
Seconds before a detached limb removes itself. Set to zero to keep the limb until cleanup or reset.
Mass in kilograms for the fallback rigid body. Articulated limbs use the masses of their physical bones.
Build a single rigid body from the detached geometry when the limb has no usable physical bones.
Path from this component to the source [MeshInstance3D]. Leave empty to find the mesh automatically.
Names of the blend shapes whose current weights carry over to a detached limb.
Replicate cuts and resets through the active Godot multiplayer peer. The node's multiplayer authority accepts cut requests and distributes the resulting state.
Use [member source_mesh_component] to narrow the automatic mesh search by name when no mesh is selected by path or the [code]Dismemberment Source[/code] group.
Multiplayer peer ID allowed to request cuts on this component. Set the node's multiplayer authority separately.
Exact name of the pelvis bone on the source skeleton. The component requires this bone during initialization.
Maps incoming bone names to cut roots before filtering. For example, map a hitbox alias to a bone on the source skeleton.
Path from this component to the source [Skeleton3D]. Leave empty to use the mesh's skeleton binding or search the nearby nodes.
Exact [MeshInstance3D] node name to match during the automatic search when [member override_source_mesh] is enabled.
Include additional skinned meshes bound to the source skeleton and transfer attachments tagged [code]Transfer Dismemberment[/code] when their bones are cut.
Use the remaining mesh's bounds for culling after a cut in Triangle Partition mode. Disable this to preserve the original bounds.
Minimum combined skin weight from the cut subtree for a vertex to count as part of the limb. Used for triangle partitioning and fallback collision geometry.
Case-sensitive bone names allowed as cut roots after remapping. Leave empty to allow any valid bone outside [member excluded_bones].
